reviews.text: Tons of good stuff and yummy treats ! With cute poppies and kitties for sale, I m against animal for sale, I support adoption. People should go to China and rescue the poor dogs and cats there . but these puppies are super cute for sure.
I would have bought the whole shop for my dogs! You can find reasonable priced treats but all accessories are very expensive!

The staff were incredibly friendly. They were the friendliest staff I've seen in Osaka. (I travel to Tokyo and Fukuoka 5-6 times a year, but I rarely go to Osaka unless it's for USJ. It had been 5 years since my last visit, and unlike before, 90% of the stores were unfriendly.)
The staff were incredibly kind! They were also very nice to my dog! I was able to buy the correct size harness! Thank you!
There was a wider variety of items than my usual Petemo, and the staff were very kind and helpful. I'll definitely come back next time I'm in the area.
Good range of dog food and treats.
Everyone is a kind staff member.
Pet lovers should this place, if you are visiting this city do shortlist this one

A must-see for cat lovers! 😄

They carry Royal Canin and Inaba products.

They also have a huge selection of other products!

The staff were polite and helpful.

They even gave me a sample! 😄
Many pets toy and variety of pet treats. A must to come for all pet lovers.

Good sized store similar to other Petemo stores. Service was great and staff were very helpful despite us not being able to speak Japanese. They were patient and nice. U can get a variety of everything your dog/cat would need here. I didn’t specifically look to see if they cater to needs of other pets.
The pet shop that used to be in the back has closed, but they still have a good selection of pet treats, including many high-quality ones.
